content.title: Hertz Stock Surges 37% on Return to Profitability. What’s Driving the Gains.
content.summary: Shares surged more than 37% to $6.83, heading for the largest same-day percentage increase since a 44% jump in April, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Peer  Avis Budget Group  was up 3.3%.  The recovery was largely due to lower depreciation of Hertz’s assets—in this case, rental cars—as measured in depreciation per unit per month, which fell 49% to $273 in the quarter.
